title: The Birth Of Astro Boy
overview: Dr Boynton is so driven by his work as a robot engineer thst he neglects his promise to spend time with his son Toby at an amusement park.  As Toby leaves the park, he is caught in a traffic collision.  Before dying, Toby has his father promise him to make the new robot in his image and treat it like a son.  Overcome with grief, Boynton completes the project and brings "Toby" to life.  Unknown to Dr Boynton, a shady criminal called Skunk stole the plans for "Toby" and plans to make a robot of his own with a new circuit known as the Omega Factor.

title: Astro Boy Vs. Atlas
overview: Dr. Boynton and Toby depart on an ocean liner for America.  Not knowing his own strength, Toby causes a huge mess during dinner.  Angrily, Dr Boynton rejects Toby on the spot, declaring that he's just a robot and that he has no son.  Meanwhile, Skunk attempts to teach Atlas his criminal ways and eventually takes Atlas on a mission to steel gold from the same boat that Dr Boynton and Toby are on...

title: The Robot Circus
overview: Toby has been enslaved by a robot circus owner and is forced into manual labour.  There he befriends a young circus worker named Kathy.  Dr Boynton's associate, Professor Elefun, comes to fetch Toby but the ringmaster refuses to let him go...  Toby receives his new name, "Astro".

title: Save the Classmate
overview: Rescued from the circus by Dr. Elefun, Astro Boy starts school and struggles with the bullying from classmates for being a robot.

title: Atlas Lives Again
overview: Astro's must stop Atlas' scheme to enslave humanity by series of technological thefts, one of which involves Astro's proposed robotic parents.

title: Robotland
overview: Astro and Dr. Elefun visit a fairytale theme park after an escaped swan/princess crash lands in their yard and tells them of the robots' plight.

title: Frankenstein
overview: Skunk convinces a powerful robot called Frankenstein to aid him in his crime spree. This crime wave leads to the deactivation of almost all robots in the city, including Astroboy.

title: The Red Cat
overview: A red cat becomes the only clue to the mystery of children who are disappearing.

title: The Crystal of the Desert
overview: While exploring a forest that has become a desert, Astro Boy discovers that Atlas is involved.

title: The White Planet
overview: Astro aids a championship racer who hopes to win a global race.

title: A Robot President
overview: Astro and his teacher, Daddy Walrus, are invited to the inauguration of the first robot president and are caught up in a plan to stop the ceremony.

title: Goliath's Head
overview: After a spacecraft crashes to the earth Astro rescues a mining robot, Goliath, from the flames.  Dr Elefun has Goliath's head removed as it contains a powerful neutron beam.  But soon the head is stolen and Goliath starts to search for it...

title: The Light Ray Robot
overview: Skunk causes trouble again, this time capturing a robot capable of invisibility hoping to use it in his schemes.

title: Uran, the Tomboy
overview: Astro meets his new sister, Uran.

title: Robio and Robiette
overview: Astro gets involved in a rivalry between robotic "families". However the two of the robots from the competing camps fall in love.

title: Astro Fights Aliens
overview: Astro captains the Second Expedition to Mars where strange creatures have been seen.

title: Save the Carolina 3
overview: Astro attempts to stop Skunk's outer space pirating attempt when one of his classmates is kidnapped.

title: The Rainbow Comet
overview: On a school field trip to see the Rainbow Comet up close, Astro and classmates are kidnapped by Atlas.

title: The Death Balloon
overview: Balloons modelled in the shape of Astro are attacking people in the city and its up to Astro to clear his name.

title: The Transformation Robot
overview: Astroboy visits a robot inhabited island where gangsters attempt loot uranium resources by enlisting the help of and a robot who can transform into any shape.

title: The Wreck of the Titan
overview: After luxury spaceliner Titan is struck by an asteroid, Astro and several others escape to the moon. They land in a crater with an atmosphere and Astro discovers the wreck of a Russian spacecraft from 1990.

title: The Liar Robot
overview: A school field trip is interrupted by a robot constantly lying about a impending earthquake.

title: The Girl from Alsoar
overview: Astro Boy meets a mysterious woman and must stop a hostile alien invasion.

title: The Greatest Robot in the World (Part 1)
overview: A power-hungry Sultan commissions a powerful fighting robot named Bruton (Pluto in the original), and sends him to battle seven of the world's strongest robots: Mont Blanc, Molnar, Brondo, Zeron, Hercules, Photar, and Astro.

title: The Greatest Robot in the World (Part 2)
overview: With only three of the most powerful robots in the world remaining (Hercules, Photar and Astro), can they stop Bruton before he destroys them all?

title: The Robot Vikings
overview: A wild gang of viking robots rampage through the city, causing havoc and destruction.

title: The Time Machine
overview: A time traveling detective arrives from the future and enlists Astro and the infamous surgeon, Black Jack, to save the life of a prince from the past.

title: The Robot Stuntman
overview: After a tour of a movie studio where Uran meets her idol, Astro has to investigate the story of a tiny stunt robot called Sam.

title: The Great Meltdown
overview: Livian appears to Astro to warn him of danger to the polar icecaps. Is Atlas involved?

title: Uran's Twin
overview: Uran gets her wish of being able to be in two places at once - this way she can stil do what her parents want and go to robot wrestling.

title: Speeding Through the Storm
overview: Whilst on a field trip to an old steam engine, a violent storm hits.

title: The Return of Queen Cleopatra
overview: Cleopatra has reappeared and Astro must find out the mystery behind her.

title: The Runaway Subway Train
overview: A brand new subway train that can go 180km/h runs out of control and Astro has to save those on board.

title: The Baby Elephant Pook
overview: After a real baby elephant is found in a robot safari park, Astro has to save both it and everyone from a giant robot elephant, Zohra.

title: The Secret of Bee City
overview: Astro and Uran visit Bee Island, but after meeting a mysterious boy they need to find out just what is going on the Bee City?

title: The Monster of Clarken
overview: A greedy gold hunter attempts to steal gold from the Golden Coral Forest. Can Astro stop him in time for the fish of reef to survive?

title: Lilly on Peligro Island
overview: Astro finds 43 messages-in-a-bottle and sneaks out at night to investigate what is going on at Peligro Island.

title: The Anti-Proton Gun
overview: The most powerful gun ever made is up for grabs in space and Astro must make sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

title: The Man-Made Solar Sphere
overview: The great detective Shalock Holmespan and Astro investigate the unusual incidents around a man-made solar sphere.

title: Blackie Young
overview: After Dr Elefun receives a large package and re-assembles the parts of a robot, Astro and Daddy Walrus travel Antarctica to investigate.

title: The Genie from Outer Space
overview: After a large meteorite falls into a mountain valley some distance away, Dr Elefun, Astro, and a team of scientists head off to investigate the crash.

title: The Robots Nobody Wanted
overview: Three robot workers that have been rejected from their jobs help Astro.

title: Atlas Forever
overview: When space stations around Saturn and Jupiter are attacked, Atlas is blamed.  After he defeats 100 ships, Astro becomes involved.

title: The Snow Leopard
overview: After it snows in summer, Astro investigates the cause.

title: Uran's Quest
overview: An Amusement Park's computer malfunctions and causes havok after Uran asks it where God lives.

title: Outer Spaceport R-45
overview: Space pirates have been raiding the area around Spaceport R-45 and Astro is needed to investigate.

title: The Hijacked Airship
overview: High-jackers take over an Airship whilst Astro and his class are visiting. Astro needs to save the day, but he has none of his powers.

title: The Human-Faced Rock
overview: There is a legend about a strange rock with the face of a man that sits on top of a mountain overlooking a village - when it turns its face towards the lake, the village will be destroyed.

title: Uran Falls in Love
overview: Uran falls in love with a Zeus the Destroyer, a robot with Astro in his sights.

title: The World of Odin
overview: Dr Elefun and Astro join Captain Claud and his crew as they search for the sacred ground of Odin.

title: The Secret of the Mayas
overview: Astro explores the Great Pyramid of the Mayas and encounters a mysterious sphinx.

title: Astro's First Love
overview: As Astro attempts to recover stolen plans for a robot he is helped by Niki, a girl robot, with whom he falls in love.
